annotations.title: Latin American VAT rates and calculation

description: Return the VAT rate (IVA, IGV, ITBIS) of one of 17 Latin American countries and, given an amount, calculate net, tax and gross. Omit pais for the full table. Brazil is excluded because it has no single rate. Use vat_price for European countries. Free demo with a daily quota; production volume: GET /latam/iva via x402.

direccion.description: neto-a-bruto (default) adds VAT; bruto-a-neto removes it.

pais.description: ISO country code, e.g. CL, MX, PE, CO, AR.

tasa.description: Rate to apply; reducida exists only for Paraguay and Uruguay.
